Generated Narrative: SearchParameter mii-sp-molgen-genomic-study-analysis-specimen

SP_MII_MolGen_GenomicStudyAnalysis_Specimen

Parameter specimen:reference

Finds analyses performed on a given specimen. The specimen sits in the genomic-study-analysis-specimen extension, so the base Procedure.specimen search parameter does not reach it.

ResourceProcedure
ExpressionProcedure.extension.where(url='http://hl7.org/fhir/uv/genomics-reporting/StructureDefinition/genomic-study-analysis-specimen').value
Target ResourcesSpecimen
Multiples
  • multipleAnd: It's up to the server whether the parameter may repeat in order to specify multiple values that must all be true
  • multipleOr: It's up to the server whether the parameter can have multiple values (separated by comma) where at least one must be true
